_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-image-load.sh (s-rta-0928 renderleft R1). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-image-load.py. Fixture images are generated per run into <out>/media (numpy seed 928, PIL compress_level 1): every path is new to the app instance.
_peakMaxMs: one 60 Hz frame period: a callback under it cannot drop a frame
_boxTol: dbox(X, Y): both arrays box-averaged in 16x16 blocks, then mean |diff| over RGB (0..255)
_fixtureMinD: a fixture pair (warm picture vs cold picture) must differ by at least this much, or the row proves nothing
_i2mFirstMaxP: C1 (Harmony adoption): the first frame that answers a capture after a 1 s dissolve onto a still-decoding image has dissolve progress <= this (about 4 frames at 60 Hz; without the pause it is the remaining decode time / 1 s)
_snapshotMaxMs: C2 (Harmony adoption): a snapshot taken while an image decodes answers within its normal time. Calibration (renderleft-fix.md): a 1080p snapshot 76-84 ms (baseline and ungated, lane + main); gated (main's in-frame decode, or the teeth build whose snapshot asks for a complete frame) 914-1442 ms. The sharp witness is the picture (i3n)
_filler: 4 flat 8192x8192 images = 1 GiB: the R1.5 prefetch budget (CompositorEngine kImagePrefetchBudgetBytes), so the pending rows' subject images are never prefetched
